rationale: The answer correctly identifies all 7 gold software items associated with T1080: S0132 (H1N1), S0133 (Miner-C), S0260 (InvisiMole), S0386 (Ursnif), S0458 (Ramsay), S0575 (Conti), and S0603 (Stuxnet).
